title: Discriminate snapshot readiness in the test-run rail badge regression
outcome: The rail badge regression proves that a nonempty running-run list stays hidden until snapshotReady becomes true, then displays the count.
acceptance: A regression renders a running run with snapshotReady=false, verifies no badge and the plain Open Test Runs label, then rerenders with snapshotReady=true and verifies the visible and accessible count; the focused check passes.
